reason: Conversation 1 never answers the homeowner's repeated, direct question about what to set the dial to, instead looping canned prompts and telling her to 'wait a day at the new setting' when nothing had been changed, so it delivered almost no usable help. Conversation 2 correctly identified the two likely causes (dial on max plus food against the rear vent), gave a concrete mid setting with a settle period, and sensibly reassured her that one yoghurt at the very back is liveable. Its weaknesses are an over-escalation to a 24-hour switch-off defrost that is poorly supported for a frost-free unit with a fine freezer, some repetition, no suggestion of a fridge thermometer and a muddled 'adjust lower' remark, but nothing unsafe and no unjustified part naming.
